Open Lake Forecast for Lake Erie
National Weather Service Cleveland OH
253 PM EST Sun Nov 15 2026

For waters beyond five nautical miles of shore on Lake Erie

Waves are the significant wave height - the average of the highest
1/3 of the wave spectrum. Occasional wave height is the average of
the highest 1/10 of the wave spectrum.

.SYNOPSIS... 
High pressure 30.50 inches will build across the Ohio Valley and 
Great Lakes tonight and lingering over the region this week. This
ridge of high pressure will dominate over Lake Erie this week 
with fair weather expected.
